# Doclyzer

> Doclyzer is a health report organization service operated by Envsoft Solutions LLP. It helps people upload blood test and other laboratory reports, review extracted values against the original document, follow results over time, organize records in separate family profiles, and choose which reports or results to share.

Doclyzer provides educational information about reports. It does not diagnose conditions, provide treatment, or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional. Automated extraction and explanations can be inaccurate; users should check important values against their original laboratory report.

The linked pages describe Doclyzer's product and legal policies. Check the effective date shown on each legal page. Doclyzer content is educational and should not be used to diagnose or treat a medical condition.

## Product

- [Doclyzer homepage](https://doclyzer.com/): Product overview, workflow, features, and frequently asked questions.

## Policies and medical safety

- [Privacy Policy](https://doclyzer.com/privacy-policy): Personal and health-report information collected, used, shared, retained, and protected by Doclyzer.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://doclyzer.com/terms-and-conditions): Rules for accounts, reports, AI explanations, credits, referrals, sharing, and use of the service.
- [Refund and Cancellation Policy](https://doclyzer.com/refund-and-cancellation-policy): Credit purchases, payment problems, cancellations, and refund requests.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://doclyzer.com/medical-disclaimer): Limits of report extraction and AI explanations; Doclyzer does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

## Account and discovery

- [Account deletion](https://doclyzer.com/delete-account): How to request account deletion and what happens afterward.
- [Sitemap](https://doclyzer.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs intended for search indexing.

Private accounts, uploaded reports, shared report links, and administrator pages are not public reference material.
